patent_title: Method for preparing acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene latex having high total solid content
monomer_ratio: butadiene: 100 parts by weight, styrene: 15.8 parts by weight, acrylonitrile: 6.7 parts by weight
water_amount: 90-110 parts by weight of ion-exchange water
emulsifier: potassium rosinate, AQUARON HS-10 as a reactive emulsifier
initiator: potassium persulfate, tertiary butylhydro peroxide, cumenehydro peroxide
coagulation: 2 parts by weight of aqueous sulfuric acid
polymer_properties: high total solid content, low coagulated material content
experimental_notes: graft-polymerizing butadiene rubber with the monomers of acrylonitrile and styrene through emulsion-polymerization
